title: noema-lite explanation facade of a language course, one locale (D19, docs/language-packs.md §3)
description: The master explanation texts of a course (written in English, inline in the course files) translated and adapted to one locale, keyed by address (tools/schemas/noema.langfacade.fields.json). Files: facades/<locale>/facade.json (this manifest, $defs.manifest), facades/<locale>/core.json and facades/<locale>/<L>.json (entries, $defs.entries), library/languages/_phenomena/facades/<locale>/<L>.json and library/languages/_typology/facades/<locale>.json (entries of the shared texts). Made by tools/lang_facade.py extract (the master as a facade) and by translation tasks (lang_facade.py task); checked by lang_facade.py parity / lint; built by tools/build.py into course.expl.<locale>.js and overlaid by langcore.applyFacade (a missing address falls back to the master). Not to be confused with the WORD facade of D14 (features / wordFeatures).

locale.description: a UI locale of docs/i18n.md §2 (en el ru fr ar-EG de hi zh-Hans zh-Hant ja it es-ES sq pt-PT)

master.description: the language of the master texts

status.description: draft: shown only with config.i18nDrafts; preview: on deploy previews; on: offered as an explanation language (with Tier 1 complete)

coverage.description: per tier: master addresses, translated, stale (src ≠ the master's hash), missing

built.description: ISO time of the last extract / parity run

files.description: the entry files of this facade (core.json, <L>.json …)

notes.description: the `for` values whose notes this facade carries: its own language, every type: / branch: / family:

entries.description: address → the translated text and the hash of the master text it was made from

src.description: sha256(master text, UTF-8), first 12 hex digits

by.description: who made it: claude (a draft), review, weblate, extract (the master itself)
